original: おい、ヴェイグ……本当に行くのか？\nまた罠かもしれねえんだぞ
traducao: Hey, Veigue... Are you really going?\nIt might be another trap, you know.

original: ……ああ。\nわかっている
traducao: ...Yeah.\nI know.

original: だったら……！
traducao: Then why...!

original: だが、逃げるわけには行かない。\nサレが逆上すれば、また無関係な人を\n傷付けるかもしれない
traducao: But I can't just run away.\nIf Saleh loses his temper, he might\nhurt more innocent people.

original: それに……、\nあいつはオレ達との決着を望んでいる
traducao: Besides...\nHe wants to settle things with us.

original: 決着なら、もう付いたはずなのに……。\nどうして、そこまで……
traducao: But we already settled things...\nWhy would he go this far...?

original: プライドの高い奴だからな……。\nとどめを刺されず生き長らえたのが\n余程屈辱的だったんだろう
traducao: He has a lot of pride...\nSurviving without being finished off\nmust have been a great humiliation.

original: それで、死んでも死に切れなくて\nこんなもの送り付けてきたってわけ？
traducao: So he couldn't just die in peace,\nand sent us this thing instead?

original: ほんと、どこまで迷惑な奴なんだヨ！\nせっかく、ヴェイグや\n○○が……
traducao: Seriously, how annoying can he be?!\nAfter Veigue and\n○○ went to all that trouble...

original: いいんだ、マオ
traducao: It's fine, Mao.

original: ○○……。\n悪いが、少し付き合ってもらえないか？
traducao: ○○...\nSorry, but will you come along?

original: どいつもこいつも\nどうしてそう、死に急ぐんだ？
traducao: Why is everyone always\nin such a hurry to die?

original: 命さえありゃ、大概の事はどうにか出来る。\n本当にどうにもならねえ事なんて\nそんなにはねえってのに……！
traducao: As long as you're alive, you can fix most\nthings. There's not much in this world\nthat's truly hopeless...!

original: ティトレイさん……
traducao: Tytree...

original: クエスト「最後の決戦」が\nエントリーされました。\nクエストカウンタから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "The Final Battle"\nhas been unlocked.\nYou can accept it at the Quest Counter.

original: ……そうか
traducao: ...I see.

original: ……○○まで\n巻き込んでしまって、すまない
traducao: ...I'm sorry for\ndragging you into this, ○○.

original: みんなで話し合ったんだけど、\nボクとヴェイグとアニーが\n○○に同行するよ
traducao: We talked it over, and\nme, Veigue, and Annie\nwill accompany ○○.

original: ユージーンさんやティトレイさんには\n万一、敵の奇襲などがあった時の為に\nここに残ってもらう事になりました
traducao: Eugene and Tytree will\nstay behind just in case\nthe enemy tries a surprise attack.

original: 今度こそ、あいつと決着を付ける
traducao: This time, I will settle things with him.

original: これで終わりにするんだ……。\n今度こそ……
traducao: I'll put an end to this...\nFor good...

original: 今度こそ和解、っていうのは……\nさすがにもう、無理……だよね？
traducao: I guess reconciling with him...\nis pretty much impossible, huh?

original: 憎しみの思念が強過ぎて、\n自分では上手く浄化する事が\n出来ないのだと思います
traducao: His feelings of hatred are too strong.\nI don't think he can purify them\non his own.

original: やはり……、\n戦いで決着を付ける以外に\nもう方法は……
traducao: As expected...\nThere's no other way\nbut to settle this in battle...

original: ここで……、あいつが待っているのか
traducao: So this is where... he's waiting.

original: サレ……！
traducao: Saleh...!

original: ヴェイグ、気を付けて。\n罠があるかもしれないよ
traducao: Veigue, be careful.\nThere might be a trap.

original: はやる気持ちもわかりますが、\nこういう時こそ、慎重に進みましょう
traducao: I know you're anxious, but\nwe must proceed carefully.

original: 思えば、サレとの付き合いも長いよね……
traducao: We've known Saleh for a long time...

original: 初めて会った時から\n嫌な奴だと思ってたけど、\nここまで曲がった性格だとは思わなかったヨ
traducao: I knew he was a jerk when we met,\nbut I didn't think his personality\nwas this twisted.

original: あの残虐さと冷酷さ……。\nどういう環境に身を置けば、\nあそこまで人に憎しみを持てるのかしら
traducao: Such cruelty and coldness...\nWhat kind of environment makes someone\nhate people that much?

original: あのネチネチした陰険な態度、\nホント徹底してるよネ！
traducao: That sneaky, insidious attitude...\nHe's really thorough about it!

original: うう、思い出しただけでも\n背中がゾクゾクしてくるヨ……
traducao: Ugh, just remembering it\nsends shivers down my spine...

original: あいつについて、オレ達が\n知っている事は少ない
traducao: We don't know much\nabout him.

original: だが、確かな事もある。\nあいつのしてきた事は決して\n許されるものではない
traducao: But there are things we do know.\nWhat he's done is something\nthat can never be forgiven.

original: それだけは絶対に言えるはずだ
traducao: That much is absolutely certain.

original: そうだね……。\n今度こそ、終わりにしなきゃ
traducao: Yeah...\nWe have to end this for good.

original: 負の思念の連鎖……。\nわたし達で断ち切りましょう
traducao: This chain of negative emotions...\nLet's break it ourselves.

original: ああ。\n行こう！
traducao: Yeah.\nLet's go!

original: がはっ……ごふ、ごほっ
traducao: Gah... Cough, cough...

original: ……勝負あったな、サレ
traducao: ...It's over, Saleh.

original: フ、フフ……ハハハハ……。\nアーハハハハ……！！
traducao: Heh, hehe... Hahaha...\nAhahahaha...!!

original: 全く……確かに、キミは……\n強くなった、よ……ヴェイグ
traducao: Goodness... You certainly...\nhave gotten stronger, Veigue.

original: キミの、顔が……苦痛に歪み\n泣き叫ぶ……姿を、見られなかった事が
traducao: It's a shame I couldn't see your face\ntwist in agony as you cried and screamed.

original: 本当に……残念で、\nたまらないよ……フフフ
traducao: It's truly...\nsuch a pity... Hehehe.

original: でも、これで……わかっただろう？\nどんなに、綺麗事を並べても\nコレが現実……
traducao: But, you understand now, don't you?\nNo matter how many pretty words you say,\nthis is reality...

original: 所詮、人間なんて\n互いに……決定的に、相容れない\nもの……なんだよ……
traducao: In the end, humans are\nfundamentally... incompatible\nwith each other...

original: オレは、そうは思わない。\nここにいる仲間や……、\nギルドのみんなは違う
traducao: I don't believe that.\nMy friends here...\nand everyone in the guild are different.

original: そして、世界も徐々に変わりつつある
traducao: And the world is gradually changing, too.

original: でも……僕はこうして……\nキミと……\nわかり合う事などなかった！
traducao: But... I ended up like this...\nI could never...\nunderstand you!

original: これが！　何を意味するかくらい\nキミにだってわかるだろう！？\nヴェイグ！！
traducao: Even you must understand\nwhat this means, right?!\nVeigue!!

original: ○○……。\nキミも所詮……まがいものの\n作られた、光……
traducao: ○○...\nYou're just a fake,\nartificial light...

original: キミが絶望に膝を屈して……、\nもがきながら、堕ちていく……日が\nいつか、来る……きっとね……
traducao: Someday, the time will come...\nwhen you fall to your knees in despair,\nstruggling as you fall... I'm sure.

original: 楽しみだなぁ……フフ……
traducao: I can't wait... Hehe...

original: フフフ……アハハハハ……！
traducao: Hehehe... Ahahahaha...!

original: アハハ……ハ……ハ……
traducao: Ahaha... ha... ha...

original: ……これで、本当に……。\n終わったんですね
traducao: ...It really is...\nover now, isn't it?

original: 最後まで、嫌な奴だったけど……。\nだけど……
traducao: He was a jerk right up to the end...\nBut...

original: 何でかな……こんなのって\n悲し過ぎるよ……
traducao: Why does this feel...\nso incredibly sad...?

original: 戻ろう。\n……みんなが待っている
traducao: Let's go back.\n...Everyone is waiting.

original: ご苦労様。\n……その様子だと、無事に\n決着は付けられたみたいね
traducao: Good work.\n...From the look on your faces,\nyou managed to settle things safely.

original: ほんとに……、\nこれで全部終わったのかな……
traducao: Is it really...\nall over now...?

original: マオ……
traducao: Mao...

original: サレの奴はもういない。\nだから、あいつに傷付けられて\n苦しむ人達ももういない
traducao: Saleh is gone now.\nSo there won't be anyone else\nhurt and suffering because of him.

original: だけど、それで全部が終わりって\nわけじゃないんだ。\n……そうだろ、ヴェイグ？
traducao: But that doesn't mean\neverything is over.\n...Right, Veigue?

original: ……ああ。\nサレとは……最後まで\nわかり合う事はなかった
traducao: ...Yeah.\nUntil the very end...\nSaleh and I couldn't see eye to eye.

original: 同じヒトでも……決定的に\n相容れない存在はある……。\nそうして争いが起こる。そんな事が
traducao: Even among humans...\nthere are incompatible existences...\nAnd so conflicts arise. Things like that

original: これから先も……、\n当たり前に続いていいはずはない
traducao: shouldn't just be allowed\nto continue from now on.

original: ヴェイグの言う通りだ
traducao: Veigue is right.

original: サレは今の時代が生んだ歪み……。\n負、そのものだったのかもしれん
traducao: Saleh was a distortion born of this era...\nPerhaps he was negativity itself.

original: サレが死んだからって……、\n何かが解決したわけじゃ、\nないんだよね
traducao: Just because Saleh is dead...\ndoesn't mean anything was actually\nsolved, does it?

original: ええ。\nむしろこれからが、\n本当の戦いなのかもしれません
traducao: Yes.\nIn fact, the real battle\nmight just be beginning.

original: だけど、少なくともこれからは\n自分達の足で歩いて\n自分達の意志で未来を築いていける
traducao: But, at least from now on,\nwe can walk on our own two feet and\nbuild a future with our own will.

original: そうだよね、○○？
traducao: Right, ○○?

original: ……そうだな。\n本当に大切なのは、これから\nオレ達が……ヒトがどうしていくかだ
traducao: ...You're right.\nWhat truly matters is what we...\nwhat humanity does from here on out.

original: そうですね。\n……わたしもそう思います
traducao: That's right.\n...I believe that, too.

original: 後ろ向きな事ばっかり考えてたって、\n仕方ないしネ！
traducao: Thinking only about negative things\nwon't get us anywhere!

original: うむ。\n今回の事を、今後にどう活かしていくかが\n課題だろうな
traducao: Indeed.\nThe challenge will be how we apply\nwhat we learned from this in the future.

original: ああ。\nヒトの心はそんなに簡単に\n駄目になっちまう様な弱いモンじゃねぇ
traducao: Yeah.\nThe human heart isn't so weak\nthat it'll break that easily.

original: 弱さも、負も、変えていけるんだ。\nおれ達は
traducao: We can change our weakness and negativity.\nWe all can.

original: うふふ。\nいつものみんなに戻ったみたいね
traducao: Hehehe.\nSeems you're back to your old selves.

original: ○○。\n今回も本当にお疲れ様。\nゆっくり体を休めてね
traducao: ○○.\nThanks again for your hard work.\nGet some good rest.

original: ……もし思い詰めそうになったら、\nわたしが懺悔を聞いてあげるから。\n遠慮しないで、いつでもいらっしゃい♪
traducao: ...If things ever get to be too much,\nI'll listen to your confessions.\nDon't hesitate to come by anytime!

original: 待ってたよ、ヴェイグ……。\nそれに、○○
traducao: I've been waiting for you, Veigue...\nAnd you, too, ○○.

original: 随分遅い到着だったねぇ？\n僕、もう待ちくたびれちゃったよ
traducao: You certainly took your time getting here.\nI was getting tired of waiting.

original: この僕をこんなに待たせて……。\nどうしてくれるのかなあ？　うん？
traducao: Making me wait this long...\nHow are you going to make it up to me? Hm?

original: サレ……最後にもう一度聞く。\nこうする以外に、他に方法はないのか？
traducao: Saleh... I'll ask one last time.\nIs there really no other way?

original: こうする以外って？
traducao: No other way?

original: まさか、この期に及んで和解しようなんて\n甘っちょろい事は考えていないよねえ？
traducao: Don't tell me you're still entertaining\nthe naive idea of reconciling?

original: 全く……。\nキミのそういうヒトらしい、\n美しくてキレイな心が……
traducao: Goodness...\nThat beautiful, pure,\nhuman-like heart of yours...

original: ……たまらなく\nヘドが出るんだよぉぉぉっ！！
traducao: ...makes me want to\npuke!!

original: ヴェイグ！！
traducao: Veigue!!

original: ……ああ。\nわかっている……！
traducao: ...Yeah.\nI know...!

original: やはり、こうするしかないのか……！
traducao: I suppose this really is the only way...!

original: ……来ます！
traducao: ...Here he comes!

original: フフフ、死ぬのが怖くなったんじゃ\nなかったのかい？
traducao: Hehehe, what's wrong?\nDid you get scared of dying?

original: でも、いいね……いいよ、その目。\n叩き潰してやりたくなる……。\n小生意気で必死な目だ！
traducao: But that's good... I like those eyes.\nThey make me want to crush you...\nSuch a cheeky, desperate look!

original: 僕、ちょっと興奮してきたよ……
traducao: I'm starting to get a little excited...

original: わかってるよね……。\n楽には死なせてあげないよ？\nハハハハハハ！！
traducao: You understand, don't you...?\nI'm not going to let you die easily.\nHahahahahaha!!
